title: Tubby Hall's press roll, wrists, and nickname
summary: Phillips praises Tubby Hall's wrists, ankles and roll, advises care of the wrists, and says Hall's nickname came from being a Tom Tom man.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Anyway, I was going to say Baby Dodds told me once that he learned his press roll partly from Tubby. Yeah, yeah. I'm surprised to hear that, but I never paid much attention to Tubby. Do you remember any press roll that he did?

He could roll, he put them in the middle of the old man Cantrell. Really? He had a tough roll. He made that even, you know, and sound like Tubby man. He had two good wrists. He was tight on the wrist. He was tight on the wrist. And he never would choke his stick that, I mean just like he would choke, try to choke somebody. He let his sticks loose, you know. Just let them go for themselves, because when you test that skin, you got some good skin on that stick, that stick will knock it down if you don't hold it. And all he would do is guard it, but he had two good wrists. He had a good wrist. And a good ankle, I can tell you, he had plenty of ankle. He had a very good ankle. And that's what you need, any way you play this drum, you need a good ankle and you need a good wrist. Two good wristes, you see. And if you take care of them, saying whether you use them or not, always keep your wrist rubbed with alcohol. I'm always rubbing, every evening when I take a bed, I rub down with alcohol, because you got to keep yourself in action, you see. A lot of guys walk a corner for parade, and when they get in the parade, they're all bamboo Thank you.
I would have said she was too tight for you, then you can't do nothing.
Mr. Tubby was fat in those days, when I knew him he was pretty heavy.
Yeah he was fat, yeah Tubby. He was fat then too. You know where he got that name from Tubby Hall, he was a Tom Tom man.
No I never did know him.
No he got it from Tom Tom, he was a Tom Tom man.
